ISA.66.10-11.text: Everyone who loves Jerusalem should rejoice with her

ISA.66.12-13.text: God will give peace and comfort to Jerusalem’s people

ISA.66.14-14.text: God’s servants will flourish, but enemies face his anger

ISA.66.15-16.text: The LORD will come with fire to judge all people

ISA.66.17-17.text: God says people who follow false worship will perish

ISA.66.18-19.text: God will gather nations to see and tell his glory

ISA.66.20-21.text: Nations will bring God’s people home to Jerusalem

ISA.66.22-23.text: God’s people will last, and all mankind will worship him

ISA.66.24-24.text: Rebels against God face a fire that never goes out
